title: Aesthetically Optimized
description: A Modpack Made to make minecraft Aesthetic along with optimizing it!!
body:
A balanced **client-side** modpack designed to enhance both **visuals** and **performance** without changing the **core gameplay.**
This version includes a wide range of **aesthetic improvements** such as **better lighting**, particles, **animations**, and **UI** enhancements, while also maintaining **solid optimization** for smooth gameplay.

**Perfect** for players who want Minecraft to look significantly better while still running efficiently.
**No server-side** mods are required — fully compatible with most multiplayer servers.

If U want to Play On public Servers Use **Fair-Play Edition** from Files

If U want Even better Performance Then Use **Optimization - Oriented Version** from Files

_You Should Download this if U want Cool visuals alongside Good Performance in only Client Side._
